sources.summary: One of the oldest surviving pharmacies in the world, Florence's Officina Profumo-Farmaceutica di Santa Maria Novella, has appointed Italian design duo Formafantasma as creative directors. Their new role will see studio founders Andrea Trimarchi and Simone Farresin focus primarily on the company's products. The studio aims to unravel their hidden histories and inform new launches, The post Formafantasma named creative directors of 800-year-old apothecary and perfumery appeared first on Dezeen .
